test_title: PYST 09: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A car can cover 275 km in 5 hours. If its speed is reduced by 5 km/h, then how much time will the car take to cover a distance of 300 km?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by the car in 5 hours = 275 km

Distance to cover = 300 km

Speed reduction = 5 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Initial speed of the car = 275 km / 5 hr = 55 km/h

New speed = 55 km/h - 5 km/h = 50 km/h

Time to cover 300 km at 50 km/h

Time = 300 km / 50 km/h

Time = 6 hours

**The car will take 6 hours to cover a distance of 300 km at the reduced speed.**
